title: Glue Data Catalog, crawlers and schema evolution

videos.script: Athena never looks for your files. It asks the Glue Data Catalog where they are, and reads what the catalog says. {{catalog}} So the catalog decides what a query can see. A day that is in S3 and not in the catalog does not exist for Athena. {{missing}} In this lesson you build that catalog by hand. A database, a table, and one row for each day of October. {{rows}} Then the crawler, the program AWS runs to fill the catalog for you. moto keeps its settings and never crawls anything, so you will see exactly where the imitation stops. {{crawler}} And then the hard part. In November the shop adds coupons, and somebody changes how totals are written. {{change}} The table changes in one request. The files never change at all. {{files}} You will watch a real reader fail on that difference, and learn the few changes a lake can take safely. {{rules}}
